Two Killed in Delhi Godown Fire After E-rickshaw Battery Blast

A fire erupted in a godown in West Delhi's Raghubir Nagar area on Tuesday, resulting in the deaths of two individuals. The blaze was reportedly triggered by an explosion in an e-rickshaw battery. The victims, identified as 17-year-old Sufaid and 38-year-old Mohd. Samid, sustained burn injuries and were taken to Guru Gobind Singh Hospital, where they were declared dead. The incident has also raised safety concerns.
